response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated background in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, GPU/AI accelerator architecture, or deep-learning workload optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured software engineering experience (15+ years) across multiple domains
Strong low-level systems programming experience (C, C++, DLang, async I/O, fibers, high-performance databases)
Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/technical training experience
concerns: No evidence of SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture experience
No exposure to AI accelerators, GPU architecture, or deep-learning workload performance optimization
Career trajectory is focused on web/mobile/full-stack product development, not hardware/performance architecture

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware co-design experience
No AI/deep-learning or GPU architecture background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
